response.sql: WITH transaction_averages AS (SELECT t.transreg AS transaction_reference, t.ordertypedist AS order_type_mix, AVG(s.shortintrt) AS avg_short_interest, AVG(s.optvolrt) AS avg_option_volume_ratio FROM transactionrecord AS t JOIN sentimentandfundamentals AS s ON s.transref = t.transreg GROUP BY t.transreg, t.ordertypedist), compared AS (SELECT transaction_reference, order_type_mix, avg_short_interest, avg_option_volume_ratio, avg_short_interest / NULLIF(AVG(avg_short_interest) OVER (PARTITION BY order_type_mix), 0) AS short_interest_ratio FROM transaction_averages) SELECT transaction_reference, order_type_mix, avg_short_interest, avg_option_volume_ratio, short_interest_ratio FROM compared ORDER BY short_interest_ratio IS NULL, short_interest_ratio DESC LIMIT 10;
